name: pdfly
description: PDFly - all your PDF tools in one place. Merge, split, compress, convert, edit and organize PDFs.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/pdf-core && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/pdf-core && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/pdf-core && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server
